tested_claim: The positive gestational-week and negative BMI associations do not depend on unequal visit frequency or any single woman.

perturbations.definition: Within each frozen domain, assign every row weight 1 divided by that woman's row count, preserving the accepted design and scaling.
perturbations.pass_rule: Week and BMI coefficient signs match the accepted run for both M1 and B1 in both domains; all weighted designs remain full-rank.

perturbations.definition: Delete one entire woman at a time, retain the accepted domain-specific design scaling, and refit each approved model.
perturbations.pass_rule: Zero week or BMI sign reversals, zero rank-deficient fits, and exactly one successful refit per woman for both methods and both domains.

non_repetition: Do not repeat the 999-sample cluster bootstrap.
Do not repeat the already-completed prospective GC-domain comparison.
Do not test dormant fallback methods.
hard_checks: Accepted primary and sensitivity cohort counts match 1082/267 and 631/251.
Accepted Q1 method definitions and input hash remain unchanged.
Raw workbook hash is unchanged before and after the robustness run.
Observed values and predeclared pass rules are saved in robustness/Q1/q1_robustness_summary.json.
verdict_rule: PASS only if every predeclared sign, rank, count and identity condition passes; otherwise CONDITIONAL or FAIL and return to human judgment without automatic fallback activation.
claim_boundary: Passing supports only directional observational stability. It cannot establish causality, strong predictive power, stable nonlinear curvature, or an individual clinical recommendation.
